decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's core competence and strategic direction, so its existing engineering know-how lets it keep interpreting results and improving this line.
The flagship designer drain builds directly on the firm's proven drainage technology and design focus, which gives it the strongest absorptive capacity for continued development.

The air-admittance valve sits outside the firm's core design-drain knowledge, which limits how much it can learn from and improve it, but it completes the system offer at low cost, so management keeps it for now.
